scenarios.name: cookie_hardening
scenarios.title: Session Cookie Hardening
scenarios.description: Checks Set-Cookie for Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite attributes.

scenarios.name: cors_policy
scenarios.title: Cross-Origin Policy
scenarios.description: Detects over-permissive CORS (wildcard origin with credentials).

scenarios.name: directory_listing
scenarios.title: Directory Listing Exposure
scenarios.description: Detects server directory autoindex pages that leak file structure.

scenarios.name: http_methods
scenarios.title: HTTP Method Hygiene
scenarios.description: Inspects advertised HTTP methods for risky verbs (via OPTIONS).

scenarios.name: open_ports
scenarios.title: Exposed Service Surface
scenarios.description: Connect-probes a fixed set of ports that should not be public.

scenarios.name: security_headers
scenarios.title: Web Security Baseline
scenarios.description: Validates that standard HTTP security response headers are enforced.

scenarios.name: sensitive_paths
scenarios.title: Sensitive Path Exposure
scenarios.description: Checks whether well-known sensitive paths are reachable.

scenarios.name: server_disclosure
scenarios.title: Software Version Exposure
scenarios.description: Detects server/software version banners that aid fingerprinting.

scenarios.name: tls_posture
scenarios.title: Transport Security Posture
scenarios.description: Validates TLS version and certificate validity via a handshake.
